user_query: JEE Mathematics section feels impossible and I can only solve 4 or 5 questions in 1 hour

user_query: Everyone in my coaching batch answers in 10 seconds while I don't even understand the question

user_query: I am hyperventilating my chest hurts and I think I am having a heart attack while studying
knowledge_context: Hyperventilation and chest tightness during study panic are physiological results of the sympathetic fight-or-flight response (adrenaline surge), not a heart condition. Initiate the 4-7-8 Somatic Vagal Reset: Inhale through nose for 4 seconds, hold gently for 7 seconds, exhale slowly with pursed lips for 8 seconds. This stimulates the vagus nerve, slowing heart rate within 90 seconds.

user_query: My mind is spinning with catastrophic thoughts of failing and being ruined
knowledge_context: Perform the 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding Protocol: Name 5 things you can see (pen, notebook, wall clock, light switch, desk corner), 4 things you can physically feel (feet flat on floor, texture of your sleeve, paper under fingers, chair against back), 3 sounds you hear (fan hum, distant traffic, your own breath), 2 scents you notice, and 1 positive affirmation: 'I am safe in this room right now.'

user_query: I cannot sleep before exams because formulas keep flashing in my head until 4 AM

Apply the 'Cognitive Brain Dump': 30 minutes before sleep, write down all racing formulas, pending chapters, and tomorrow's first task on paper. Close the notebook physically to signal completion to your brain. Dim ambient lights and avoid phone screens for 45 minutes before sleep to allow melatonin release.

user_query: If I do not get AIR under 500 my entire life is meaningless and ruined
